episodes.label: Watching From Above: Big Gods, Moralizing Supernatural Punishment & the Great Seshat Coding War — Göbekli Tepe & the Holocene anonymity crisis; Norenzayan's Big Gods & CREDs synthesis; Purzycki's 8-society 35,400-coin Nature field experiment; Watts's Austronesian ritual human sacrifice & elite coercion; Whitehouse's 2019 Seshat refutation, Beheim's 2021 NA-to-0 missing-data audit & Nature retraction; Lightner-Bendixen-Purzycki on small-scale moralizing spirits & Whitehouse's 2023 retake; secular deterrence collapse math, missing-data odds-ratio distortion & spotting Big Gods tests in disguise
episodes.notes: How did an ape built for face-to-face foraging bands of 50 relatives scale up into anonymous megasocieties of millions thousands of years before police forces or courts existed? This five-act adversarial deep dive puts Ara Norenzayan's Big Gods and Moralizing Supernatural Punishment Hypothesis on full empirical trial. Examine the landmark behavioral proof in Purzycki and colleagues' eight-society Nature field experiment measuring 35,400 real-stakes coin allocations across Vanuatu, Fiji, Brazil, Mauritius, Siberia, and Tanzania; confront the dark coercive twin revealed by Watts and colleagues' Nature phylogenetic study of Austronesian ritual human sacrifice stabilizing hereditary inequality; and relive the most dramatic methodological courtroom clash in modern anthropology—Whitehouse and the Seshat consortium's 2019 Nature claim that megasocieties preceded Big Gods, Bret Beheim and colleagues' 2021 forensic audit exposing how recoding pre-literate missing values as zeros manufactured the jump and forced a Nature retraction, Lightner, Bendixen, and Purzycki's 2022 demonstration that small-scale societies already possess local moralizing spirits, and Whitehouse's 2023 corrected Seshat retake. Pause twice for worked quantitative calculations mapping secular gossip collapse across Holocene settlement scales and proving exact missing-data odds-ratio distortion plus Galton-adjusted regional transition power, then walk away with a pre-registered Head-to-Head Crucial Experiment protocol and a practical field guide for recognizing Big Gods, doctrinal ritual, coercion, and affluence hypotheses hiding in disguise.

episodes.label: Marcus Aurelius & Lee Kuan Yew (121–180 CE / 1923–2015) — The Antonine Plague Notebook & the 1965 Separation Tears: Two Reluctant Stewards of Asymmetric Survival
episodes.notes: Pairs Roman philosopher-emperor Marcus Aurelius (121–180 CE) with modern Singapore's founding architect Lee Kuan Yew (1923–2015) across eighteen centuries to dissect Stoic self-command against unsentimental institutional state-building under sudden existential shock. Follows teenage Marcus sleeping on bare boards and waiting twenty-three quiet years under Antoninus Pius before facing the devastating Antonine Plague, Galen's eyewitness medical crisis, the frozen Marcomannic Wars, his two-month Trajan's Forum palace-treasure auction, burning Avidius Cassius's treasonous letters unread, writing private Greek reminders by tent lamp at Carnuntum, and confronting the dynastic trap of Commodus; then traces young Harry Lee dodging the 1942 Japanese Sook Ching massacre queue, taking a Cambridge double-first, riding and breaking the pro-communist union tiger, weeping on live television during Singapore's sudden August 9, 1965 expulsion, absorbing Britain's East-of-Suez pullout, and building Singapore's four-pillar survival engine (English-first MNC leapfrogging, CPIB anti-corruption and benchmarked pay, HDB/CPF mass homeownership with ethnic quotas, and Israeli-advised military deterrence) alongside a candid quantitative audit of both fifty-year compounding growth (USD 516 to USD 55,647 per capita) and its steep civil-liberty cost before Lee's rare 1990 voluntary step-down.
